rationale: The agent changed the payment method on the order without first confirming the order-changing action, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. It also failed to provide the requested gift card balance or determine whether the gift card could be applied to the order. Additionally, the agent stated details (prior charge to Mastercard and a 5–7 business day refund window) without showing tool-backed support for these specifics. While a user lookup was performed, the core requests were not fully addressed, and the write was executed prematurely. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
